title: Junior Data Scientist
raw_text: Our internal analytics team is expanding, and we are looking for a Junior Data Scientist to help us interpret complex behavioral data and build foundational predictive systems. Our data department consists of five practitioners, including senior scientists and data engineers, working closely on core user retention products. In this role, your day-to-day responsibilities will include writing clean Python scripts to extract clean datasets, utilizing pandas 2.0 and NumPy for exploratory data analysis, and building basic classification models via scikit-learn 1.3. You will maintain automated data validation scripts and assist in deploying model endpoints using Flask. Our technical stack strictly requires Python 3.10, pandas, scikit-learn, and SQL, with preferred exposure to PyTorch 2.0 and Git workflows. Success in the first six months means independently managing your assigned data preprocessing pipelines, contributing verified code to our shared repositories, and successfully taking at least one baseline predictive model from training into a testing environment. You will collaborate frequently with product managers to gather analytical requirements and work alongside QA engineers to validate data integrity. This position offers a distinct growth opportunity to learn enterprise MLOps standards directly from senior mentors and gradually assume ownership over core machine learning microservices.
responsibilities: Write Python scripts to extract and preprocess behavioral datasets
Perform exploratory data analysis using pandas and NumPy
Build and evaluate basic classification models via scikit-learn
Maintain automated data validation scripts and assist with Flask deployments
requirements: Minimum 1 year of professional or intensive academic experience in data science
Proficiency with Python 3.10, pandas, and scikit-learn
Solid understanding of SQL and relational database structures
nice_to_have: Familiarity with PyTorch 2.0 or related deep learning frameworks
Experience with Git version control and collaborative coding
education_requirement: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Statistics, or a related field

title: Machine Learning Engineer
raw_text: We are seeking an experienced Mid-Level Machine Learning Engineer to join our growing core platform group. The team is comprised of six dedicated engineers focused on delivering intelligent automation tools for our enterprise SaaS product lines. Your day-to-day responsibilities will center on designing and maintaining scalable machine learning pipelines, implementing production-grade models using scikit-learn 1.4 and XGBoost, and optimizing deep learning workloads within PyTorch 2.1. You will be responsible for orchestrating these batch and real-time processing workflows using Apache Airflow and packaging services via Docker containers. The required technical stack includes Python, pandas, scikit-learn, PyTorch, Apache Airflow, Docker, and PostgreSQL. Preferred skills include experience with AWS cloud services and FastAPI. Success in the first six months involves successfully migrating two legacy statistical models into containerized Airflow pipelines and improving overall model training throughput by at least 20%. You will collaborate closely with data infrastructure engineers to optimize data access patterns, product managers to define functional requirements, and frontend teams to align on API contracts. This role provides an exceptional scope of impact, allowing you to establish best practice standards for model tracking and orchestration across the entire department.
responsibilities: Design and maintain scalable machine learning training and inference pipelines
Implement production-grade models using scikit-learn, XGBoost, and PyTorch
Orchestrate batch and real-time workflows using Apache Airflow
Package machine learning services into Docker containers for deployment
requirements: Minimum 3 years of professional experience as a Machine Learning Engineer
Strong proficiency with Python, pandas, scikit-learn, and PyTorch
Proven experience with Apache Airflow and Docker containerization
nice_to_have: Experience deploying applications on AWS ECS or EKS
Familiarity with building APIs using FastAPI
education_requirement: Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science or related quantitative field

title: Senior Data Scientist / Technical Lead
raw_text: We are searching for a Senior Data Scientist and Technical Lead to pioneer the next generation of our high-throughput predictive risk engines. The specialized data science division comprises twelve senior engineers and researchers building high-frequency transaction analysis tools. Your day-to-day responsibilities will involve architecting production-level deep learning systems using PyTorch 2.2, establishing framework standards for scikit-learn 1.4 implementations, and optimizing distributed data processing scripts written in pandas and NumPy. You will own the full deployment lifecycle, designing low-latency model APIs via FastAPI 0.105, managing relational data layers within PostgreSQL 16, and supervising cloud architecture on AWS ECS. Our required technical stack is composed of Python, PyTorch, scikit-learn, FastAPI, AWS ECS, and PostgreSQL, while experience with MLflow and Kubernetes is highly preferred. Success in the first six months looks like auditing our existing real-time scoring engine, leading the architecture redesign to drop p99 inference latency below 20ms, and mentoring junior engineers through code reviews. You will collaborate daily with executive stakeholders to align data strategy with business goals, product directors to map feature requirements, and DevOps leads to ensure seamless infrastructure provisioning. The scope of impact is immense, giving you full technical autonomy over our core algorithmic frameworks.
responsibilities: Architect enterprise-grade, low-latency deep learning systems using PyTorch
Establish modeling and validation standards for scikit-learn across the engineering department
Design and deploy scalable model APIs using FastAPI hosted on AWS ECS
Optimize distributed data processing and feature engineering using pandas and NumPy
requirements: Minimum 6 years of professional experience in data science or machine learning engineering
Deep specialization in PyTorch and designing production-ready deep learning models
Extensive experience with FastAPI, AWS ECS cloud infrastructure, and PostgreSQL
nice_to_have: Experience with MLflow or alternative model registry and tracking tools
Familiarity with distributed orchestration using Kubernetes
education_requirement: Master's or PhD degree in Statistics, Computer Science, or equivalent technical discipline
